output.title: Known issue: dashboard slow to load with 10,000+ rows
output.content: Dashboards with more than 10,000 rows currently load slowly because pagination is not yet applied server-side. Workaround: filter the dashboard by date range to reduce the row count. A server-side pagination fix is on the roadmap but has no committed release date.

output.title: Data export / GDPR requests
output.content: To request a full export of your account data for GDPR or personal record-keeping purposes, go to Account Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export. The export is prepared within 30 days and sent as a download link to your account email.

output.title: API rate limits
output.content: The API allows 100 requests per minute on the Free and Pro plans, and 1000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan. Exceeding the limit returns an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header.

steps.rawOutput:
**Draft reply:**

---

Thank you for reporting this issue. We understand how frustrating slow dashboard load times can be, especially when it's impacting your workflow.

We've identified a known issue that may be affecting your dashboard: **dashboards with more than 10,000 rows currently load slowly because server-side pagination has not yet been implemented.** This aligns with what you're experiencing as your data has grown.

**Immediate workaround:**
Try filtering your dashboard by date range to reduce the row count. This should improve load times significantly while you continue to work with the data.

**Long-term fix:**
Server-side pagination is on our roadmap to address this performance issue. However, I don't have a committed release date to share at this time.

Could you let us know:
1. Approximately how many rows are you currently displaying on your main dashboard?
2. Does applying a date range filter improve the load time for you?

This information will help us better understand your situation and explore whether there are any additional optimization options available. We appreciate your patience as we work to improve dashboard performance.

---
